acceptance: The archived lock-lease Work Item knowledge record is regenerated from the archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, and manifest, and all recorded evidence digests are current.
The deterministic knowledge index is regenerated and `make ai-check-knowledge-index` passes without modifying archived evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The generated lock-lease knowledge projection is rebound to the immutable archived evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The record and index resolve the archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, and manifest with current SHA-256 bindings, while archived bytes remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the canonical record/index generators, compare the generated projection to the source-bound checker, and hash the archived inputs before and after.

guidelines: Generated knowledge projections must be produced by repository commands, not hand-edited.
Archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, and manifest files are immutable evidence and must not be rewritten.
Only the declared lock-lease knowledge record and deterministic index may change in this repair.

intent.problem: PR #906 merged the lock-lease archive with rebound Summary and Outcome digests, but ai-close-work-item now rejects the merged result because its generated Implementation Knowledge record and index still carry stale evidence digests.
constraints: Repair only the generated knowledge record and index from the existing archived evidence.
Do not rewrite archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, archive manifest, or archive index bytes.
Do not publish, tag, or modify v0.5.68 release assets in this repair.
Use the canonical knowledge generators and record every verification result in the Summary.
intent.rationale: The stale projection is a post-merge lifecycle defect that blocks clean closure of the already merged #906 Work Item. Rebuilding the projection from immutable archived evidence restores the closure invariant without changing the accepted feature or historical facts.

rawUserRequest: Repair the stale generated knowledge projection discovered while closing the merged lock-lease Work Item, then verify that the projection is fresh and closure can proceed.

declaredIntent.summary: Repair the stale generated knowledge projection that blocks closure of the merged lock-lease Work Item.
